description: Rotates the channels of a polyphonic cable and sets how many channels come out, with a display and a CV output of the input's channel count.

params.text: Rotates the channels of the input, -16 to +16, so a setting of 1 sends input channel 2 out on channel 1 and so on; the rotation CV is added to it.
Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16, or automatic at the far left, which matches the input's channel count; the channel count CV is added to it.

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are rotated.
Adds to the rotation knob, one channel of rotation for every 0.625V.
Adds to the output channel count knob, one channel for every 0.625V.

outputs.text: A voltage for the number of channels on the input, 0.625V per channel, so sixteen channels gives 10V.

menu: Rotation Mode — sets what the rotation wraps around, as Repeat Input Channels, Rotate Through Maximum of Output, Input Channels, or Rotate Through 16 Channels (Legacy).
